originalTitle: Dow, S&P 500 close at records on AI results, Mideast deal hopes
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes surged on Tuesday, with the Dow and S&P 500 both gaining roughly one-and-three quarters percent to notch record-high closes, and the Nasdaq climbing more than two-and-a-half percent. Investors eagerly awaited SpaceX's first earnings results since its IPO, delivered after the close. Elon Musk's rocket and AI company reported a more than 90% rise in revenue for the quarter, buoyed by strong growth in its Starlink satellite-internet and AI businesses. The company posted a net loss of more than $540 million and capital expenditures of over $18 billion. Its shares, which closed up, gave back most of those gains in extended trading. The stock, which has fallen 8% since SpaceX's record-breaking IPO in June, could face further pressure this week when the lock-up period expires, notes Rob Haworth, senior investment strategy director at U.S. Bank Asset Management Group. "I think the market's probably a little worried that we're going to see more shares being offered, although we've been below the IPO price, so we'll have to see. But we think this remains a really important year for IPO markets as we have OpenAI and Anthropic coming as well. This will really start to unlock this private equity market and get some fresh capital to work. And then I think it's a question of how do markets adapt to this, right? How do markets adapt to all these new providers, which are model companies, and incorporate those into the overall ethos? So this is going to remain a really interesting year when it comes to some fresh blood into the U.S. equity market." :: AMD Also after the close, AMD said its second-quarter revenue rose 50% year-over-year, beating analysts' expectations. But the stock, which closed 7% higher, erased those gains in extended trading. In other earnings news, Palantir Technologies grabbed headlines after its CEO delivered what he called "otherworldly" results, with the software company raising its annual revenue forecast. Shares skyrocketed more than 29% to record their biggest daily percentage gain since February of 2024. :: Caterpillar And shares of Caterpillar, seen as a bellwether for the global industrial economy, jumped about five-and-a-half percent after the company raised its annual revenue growth forecast, as the buildout of AI data centers has fueled demand for its power-generation and construction equipment. Meanwhile, crude prices settled down about 5% after a Qatari official said efforts to secure a diplomatic resolution to the Iran conflict were continuing, while U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz could come within the next two days.

chineseTitle: 道指、标准普尔 500 指数收盘 AI 业绩创历史新高，中东交易希望
chineseSummary: 故事：周二，华尔街主要股指飙升，道指和标准普尔 500 指数均上涨约四分之三，创下收盘纪录新高，纳斯达克指数上涨逾百分之二半。投资者热切等待 SpaceX 自 IPO 以来的首份财报（收盘后公布）。埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的火箭和人工智能公司报告称，在星链卫星互联网和人工智能业务强劲增长的推动下，本季度收入增长了 90% 以上。该公司公布的净亏损超过 5.4 亿美元，资本支出超过 180 亿美元。其股价收盘上涨，在盘后交易中回吐了大部分涨幅。合众银行资产管理集团高级投资策略总监 Rob Haworth 指出，自 SpaceX 6 月份破纪录的 IPO 以来，该股已下跌 8%，本周锁定期到期后，该股可能面临进一步压力。 “我认为市场可能有点担心我们会看到更多的股票发行，尽管我们已经低于 IPO 价格，所以我们必须拭目以待。但我们认为这对于 IPO 市场来说仍然是非常重要的一年，因为 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 也即将到来。这将真正开始释放这个私募股权市场并获得一些新的资本。然后我认为这是一个市场如何适应这一点的问题，对吗？市场如何适应所有这些新的提供商，这些提供商是因此，当涉及到美国股市的新鲜血液时，今年将仍然是非常有趣的一年。” :: AMD 收盘后，AMD 还表示，其第二季度营收同比增长 50%，超出了分析师的预期。但该股收盘上涨 7%，在长时间交易中抹去了这些涨幅。在其他方面
